description: This file contains unit tests for the SubPanelRowCounter class in SuiteCRM, testing functions like subpanel row counting, query conversions, and related logic.

classes.name: SubPanelTest
classes.description: Unit test class extending SuitePHPUnitFrameworkTestCase for testing SubPanelRowCounter functionalities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment, ensuring the 'sugarEntry' constant is defined.

methods.name: testFaultySubpanelDef
methods.description: Tests behavior when subpanel definitions are faulty or empty, expecting a row count of -1.

methods.name: testSelectQueryToCountQuery
methods.description: Verifies conversion of SELECT queries to COUNT queries, including cases with aliases and AS clauses.

methods.name: testMakeFunctionCountQuery
methods.description: Tests the creation of COUNT queries from function references within the class.

methods.name: testMakeSubPanelRowCountQuery
methods.description: Checks the construction of subpanel row count SQL queries given subpanel definitions.
